statement: Hyperscaler custom silicon (Google, AWS, Microsoft, Meta) is projected to grow from $8B in 2024 to $15B in 2025E and over $25B in 2026E, reaching 10-15% combined share.
why: In-house accelerators are the largest structural threat to merchant GPU share because the buyers building them are also the biggest merchant customers.

impact.mechanism: Rapid growth in hyperscaler-designed silicon substitutes for merchant GPU purchases at the largest accounts while expanding total accelerator supply.

evidence.excerpt: Custom silicon (Google, AWS, Microsoft, Meta) market segment size (verbatim): 2022 "$2B"; 2023 "$3B"; 2024 "$8B"; 2025E "$15B"; 2026E "$25B+". Projected combined share "10-15% by 2026".

confidence.basis: Secondary analyst projection with no primary corroboration; figures for 2025 and 2026 are estimates.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 5.8 -> 25.0 (tol 1%); sources: Silicon Analysts
